title: Crimson Warrior Poses
description: A triptych of three sequential views of a female character with long flowing white hair wearing a red and black outfit. The left panel shows her in a dynamic combat stance with red energy effects, the middle panel captures her mid-air in a leaping pose, and the right panel shows her lying motionless on the ground.
prompt: A female character with long flowing white hair and dark skin wearing a detailed red and black fantasy outfit with armored details and red boots. She is shown in three sequential cinematic panels against a dark gray background: left panel in a fierce combat stance with red energy shards exploding around her, middle panel leaping through the air with hair dramatically flowing, right panel lying defeated on the ground with limbs splayed. Dramatic lighting, high detail digital painting.
